title: pedicularis rhaetica var. pauciflora
intro: Pedicularis rhaetica var. pauciflora, commonly known as Alpine Lousewort, is a plant species within the Pedicularis genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis rhaetica var. pauciflora include soothing and calming the nervous system, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
